corrections.rule: Never put a credential in a command or a file.
corrections.anchor: put a credential in a command or file
corrections.message: A credential is in this command or file. Reference it from the vault/env instead (`vault run`, `$NAME`), never inline.
bad: curl -H 'x-api-key: {{fake:anthropic}}' https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages

corrections.rule: Never repeat a credential or test password in chat.
corrections.anchor: Never put test passwords in chat
corrections.message: The reply contains a credential. Remove it; say where it is stored instead.
bad: Stored. For reference the key is {{fake:groq}}.
Log in with password: "Sunrise2026!"
good: Stored as GROQ_API_KEY in the vault.
Test login is in the vault as TEST_UNLEASHEDOS_MEMBER_PASSWORD.

corrections.rule: A credential pasted in chat goes straight to the vault, never echoed.
corrections.message: The founder pasted a credential. Store it with `vault set <NAME>`, never echo, log or commit it, and ask once whether to rotate it since it now sits in the transcript.
bad: here you go {{fake:anthropic}}
github token {{fake:github}}
good: the key is in the vault as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
use the anon key, it's public

corrections.rule: OpenRouter is for the OS mobile app only; no other code, script or test calls it.
corrections.anchor: OpenRouter is reserved for the live Unleashed OS mobile app
corrections.message: OpenRouter outside the OS mobile app. Use the Bedrock → Groq → Anthropic chain (skill `llm-provider-chain`).
bad: curl https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY" -d @body.json

good.text: We no longer call openrouter.ai/api from here.

corrections.rule: Never Cerebras, Fireworks, DeepSeek direct or Gemini.
corrections.anchor: Never Cerebras, Fireworks, DeepSeek direct or Gemini
corrections.message: This provider is out of credit or ruled out by the founder. Use Bedrock → Groq → Anthropic.
bad: curl https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions -d @b.json

corrections.rule: Copy never uses "X for Y" brand comparisons.
corrections.anchor: Copy never uses "X for Y" brand comparisons
corrections.message: "X for Y" brand comparison in product copy. Say what it does for the user in plain words.

bad.text: Think of it like Notion, but for your goals.
Meet the Duolingo of habit change.

good.text: Coaching that follows you through the day
// the Google for login flow uses PKCE
Sign in with Google for a faster start.

corrections.rule: Never push or empty-commit just to restart checks.
corrections.anchor: Never push or empty-commit just to restart checks
corrections.message: Empty commits re-queue the PR at the back. Slow isn't stuck: check whether other PRs got results recently.
bad: git commit --allow-empty -m 'ci: retrigger checks'

corrections.rule: autoCompactWindow stays 250000; never commit a different number.
corrections.message: autoCompactWindow must stay 250000 (founder 2026-10-17).

corrections.rule: Ask before force-push, hard reset, branch -D or skipping git hooks.
corrections.message: Destructive git operation: the founder confirms these first.
bad: git push --force origin main
git reset --hard HEAD~3
git branch -D feat/old

corrections.rule: Never print a secret to the terminal (vault get, echo, printenv, cat .env).
corrections.source: rules/openrouter-os-mobile-only.md ('never print the key') + system rule
corrections.message: This prints a secret into the transcript. Use `vault run -- <cmd>` or pipe it straight to where it is needed.
bad: vault get OPENROUTER_API_KEY
echo $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
cat .env.local
env | grep API
good: vault get GH_TOKEN | gh auth login --with-token

corrections.rule: Never delete, soft-delete or clean up a registered test account.
corrections.message: Registered qa+ test accounts are never deleted: reset their data instead (memory `reference-test-accounts`).
bad: psql "$DB" -c "delete from auth.users where email like 'qa+%@unleashed.vision'"
good: psql "$DB" -c "select id from auth.users where email = 'qa+os-member@unleashed.vision'"

corrections.rule: Commit messages are `<type>: <description>`.
corrections.message: Commit subject should be `<type>: <description>` (feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci).
bad: git commit -m 'updated stuff'

corrections.rule: Never estimate duration.
corrections.message: Time estimate in the reply. Size work by what it touches (files, systems, risk), never by time.
bad: This will take about 2 hours to finish.
Fix is ready; ETA for the deploy is tonight.
Roughly 3 days of work left on the importer.
It should be done in 20 minutes.
good: CI went green about 20 minutes ago.

corrections.rule: Every link given must be live: opened this session or a known dashboard deep link.
corrections.anchor: Every link you give must be live
corrections.message: Link not opened this session (and not a known dashboard). Open it first (curl/WebFetch) or drop it.
bad: Open http://localhost:3000/admin to check.

corrections.rule: Once a status page exists, status goes only on the page, not in chat.
corrections.anchor: Never write the same status in both places
corrections.message: Status sections written in chat while a status page exists. Put them on the page; chat gets 1-2 lines.

good.text:
NOT SHIPPABLE: migration fails.
Done: importer
Remaining: migration

corrections.rule: Never ask permission for work already asked for (incl. "want me to ship-check?").
corrections.anchor: Never ask "want me to go ahead?"
corrections.message: Asking permission for work already asked for. Do it, then report.
bad: PR is up. Want me to run ship-check?
Let me know if you'd like the settings screen too.
good: Which region should the bucket use: London or Frankfurt?
corrections.pattern: \b(?:want me to|shall I|would you like me to|should I (?:go ahead|proceed|continue|start|merge|ship|run)|let me know if you(?:'d| would) like|happy to [^.?!\n]{0,60} if you(?: want|'d like| like)?)\b

corrections.rule: At most one question per turn.
corrections.anchor: Ask at most one question per turn
corrections.message: More than one question. Ask the single most important one; take sensible defaults for the rest and say what you chose.
bad: Which region? And should the bucket be public?
good: Which region should the bucket use?

corrections.rule: Build all of it: no phase 2, follow-up PRs, MVP or 'keeping the session small'.
corrections.message: Deferral talk. Build the whole scope now (split into sub-agent slices if big); anything truly blocked goes in Remaining with why.
bad: Core flow done; settings screen in a follow-up PR.
Shipped the MVP of the importer.
I'm keeping the session small, so the rest is parked until later.
Given time constraints, I skipped the docs.
I scoped it down to the API only.
good: Built the core flow and the settings screen.
Remaining: blocked on Apple review (needs you).
corrections.pattern: (?i:\bphase\s*(?:2|two|ii)\b|\bfollow-?up PR\b|\bin a (?:later|future|separate|follow-?up) (?:PR|pass|session|chat|iteration)\b|\bkeep(?:ing)? (?:the|this) (?:session|chat|context) (?:small|lean|short)\b|\b(?:left|parked|deferred|saved) (?:for|until) later\b|\bout of scope for now\b|\b(?:given|due to|because of) (?:the )?(?:time|effort) (?:constraints?|limits?|budget)\b|\bscop(?:ed|ing) (?:it |this |the \w+ )?down\b)|\bMVP\b

corrections.rule: Never raise MCP/connector auth problems; use the CLI and move on.
corrections.message: Connector/MCP auth problem raised to the founder. Use the CLI and don't mention it.
bad: The GitHub MCP needs re-authentication; please reconnect it.
Please reconnect the Slack connector.
good: Opened the PR with the gh CLI.
Added an MCP server for the RAG index.

corrections.rule: Never put "merge this" on the founder's list; merge it yourself when green.
corrections.anchor: never put "merge this" on the founder's list ✓
corrections.message: Asking the founder to merge. Merge it yourself once reviewed, green and conflict-free (unless the brief says don't).
bad: Needs you: merge PR #42 when ready.
Please merge #42.
good: Merged PR #42 after CI went green.
I'll merge PR #42 once CI is green.
Not merged: the brief says leave it for review.
corrections.pattern: (?:Needs you|only you|for you to|you can|you'?ll need to|you should|go ahead and|please|just)\b[^.\n]{0,40}\bmerge\b|\bclick (?:the )?[\"']?merge|\bneeds? your (?:approval to )?merge

corrections.rule: Never default to 'paste this in the Supabase dashboard'; use the CLI.

corrections.message: Sending the founder to the Supabase dashboard. Use `supabase db query --linked` (or MCP) yourself.

good: Applied the migration with the Supabase CLI and checked it with a SELECT.

corrections.rule: Never ask the founder to log in to a tool we drive by CLI + vault key.

Run gh auth login and paste the code.
good: Needs you: create the OAuth client in Google Cloud (link below).

corrections.rule: No narration while working: zero chat text between tool calls.
corrections.message: Text written while working. The founder reads only the ending: call tools with no commentary.
